_readme: S447 SkyBrittlebush, 2026-10-22. Santa Barbara City's capture finds 249 of 319 programs: 18 not found and 20 page-claimed, and S446's free capture under the per-heading rules moved neither (248 found, 21 page-claimed). Ten of the page-claimed are Administration of Justice programs (Law Enforcement, Criminology, Legal Studies; A.S., A.S.-T and certificates) that fall back to the Liberal Arts and Political Science pages; their own pages were never captured. Found pages sit at /academic-departments/<department>/<program>/; Law, Public Policy, and Society AA-T is under /academic-departments/justice-studies/. This read asks the sitemap whether it lists the missing programs' pages, and the Justice Studies department which programs it links. Two loads, no model call.

questions.sitemap_program_pages: Whether the sitemap lists the missing programs' pages (Administration of Justice, Engineering A.S., French, Philosophy AA-T, Film/TV AS-T, Screenwriting, Technical Writing, CIS System Administration), and at which addresses.
questions.justice_links: Which programs the Justice Studies department page links, and under what titles.
